articles.title: US weighs lifting sanctions on Iran's 'shadow fleet' to address surging costs
articles.summary:
US weighs lifting sanctions on Iran's 'shadow fleet' to address surging costs

The US is considering lifting sanctions on “shadow fleet” tankers tied to Russia and Iran to address soaring diesel prices ahead of midterm elections, according to multiple reports and a senior US official.

US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in a video address to an energy forum in Riyadh this week that the Trump administration was discussing easing sanctions on shadow fleet vessels to address record freight rates that have driven up costs of shipping American energy abroad, Energy Aspects, a research group, said.

The Financial Times reported on Thursday that the US could allow the sale of blacklisted vessels to non-sanctioned operators and lift sanctions, allowing them to operate without restrictions.

Reuters reported the US could allow “legal oil" to flow on previously sanctioned vessels, effectively allowing sanctioned ships to carry crude or petroleum products not sanctioned by the US.

Iran’s shadow fleet rose in full force in 2018, after the US unilaterally withdrew from a nuclear agreement with Iran and global powers, officially titled the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action. The US imposed debilitating sanctions on Iran and has honed in on its oil industry.

Energy Aspects estimates that around 15 percent of the world's tanker fleet is under US sanctions.

Read more: US weighs lifting sanctions on Iran's 'shadow fleet' to address surging costs

articles.title: Hormuz controlled by US and allies, not Iran: Centcom chief
articles.summary:
Hormuz controlled by US and allies, not Iran: Centcom chief

The Strait of Hormuz "is controlled by the United States and our regional partners, not Iran", the head of US Central Command (Centcom) has said.

In a video statement, Centcom commander Brad Cooper said the US blockade of Iranian ports had imposed "a devastating cost" on the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).

He said it had completely halted Iran's maritime exports and imports, "with the exception of humanitarian assistance we have allowed in".

Cooper said the US had "prevented Iran from exporting at least 25 billion dollars worth of crude oil" and had "significantly degraded Iran's ability to project power far beyond its borders".

He added that US forces had helped Gulf allies ship more than 100 million barrels of crude through the strait in the past week, with around 400 merchant vessels passing through.

In total, the US had helped regional partners move 1.3 billion barrels through Hormuz in recent months, he said.

articles.title: Israeli fire kills at least three Palestinians across Gaza
articles.summary:
Israeli fire kills at least three Palestinians across Gaza

Israeli forces killed at least three Palestinians across the Gaza Strip on Friday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported.

In northern Gaza, Hatem Khalil Abu Hasanein, 40, was shot dead by an Israeli quadcopter drone in the al-Tawam area, according to Wafa’s correspondent.

Later in the evening, an Israeli air strike hit a group of Palestinians in the al-Nasr neighbourhood, west of Gaza City, killing one person and wounding several others.

In the south, Israeli troops opened fire on Palestinians in al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, killing a woman.

Israeli forces have killed over 1,500 Palestinians since the October 2025 “ceasefire”, according to Gaza's health ministry.

articles.title: Critically acclaimed video game Big Walk not released on Xbox to support BDS movement
articles.summary:
Critically acclaimed video game Big Walk not released on Xbox to support BDS movement

Submitted by Nouran Saleh on Fri, 10/16/2026 - 18:03
Developers from House House explain their boycott of Microsoft as they skip Xbox in the release of their hit game
Screen grab from Big Walk by House House's official game website
Off

Big Walk, a co-op puzzle adventure game, hasn't been featured on Xbox since its August launch, and the developers said it was to align with the Palestinian-led Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement guidelines.

House House, the Australian studio behind the critically acclaimed game, released Big Walk earlier this year on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, while leaving out Xbox Series X and S. In a statement, the developers explained that the reason is that Xbox’s Microsoft is on the BDS list. 

An explanation on why Big Walk isn't available on Xbox.https://t.co/XYv772bLej pic.twitter.com/R0jGds8dRv

— House House (@house_house_) October 15, 2026

“We would love for people to be able to play the game on Xbox, but not until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets.

We’ve made this decision with the belief that meaningful change can be made in the world, that coordinated collective action can confront even the most powerful interests, and that one day, Palestine will be free,” House House wrote in its statement. 

The BDS movement listed Microsoft around June 2025 over its ties to the Israeli military and government, citing the use of Microsoft technology in the surveillance of Palestinians. The boycott call also extends to Microsoft’s Xbox consoles, gaming accessories and other products.

BDS released a statement online in support of House House’s move and is calling all “games journalists and workers to sign the No Games for Genocide pledge and boycott Microsoft’s Xbox”.

We salute House House’s principled stance and call on all gamers, game developers, games journalists and workers to sign the No Games for Genocide pledge and boycott Microsoft’s Xbox until Microsoft ends its shameful complicity in Israel’s crimes against Palestinians. pic.twitter.com/JJiE8rKcMR

— BDS movement (@BDSmovement) October 16, 2026

Ethical or performative?

The reactions online have been mixed, with some completely supporting the boycott and applauding the developers for their stance; others aren’t as encouraging, labelling the move as ‘performative’. 

More people need to be vocal about Microsoft being a BDS target. Good on House House. https://t.co/AVfXYukJw2

— A Pickle Rick for the Knowing Ones (@HolierThanMao) October 15, 2026

One person wrote on X: “If @house_house_ caring that much about palestinians then they should boycott SONY too. SONY literally sold equipment to various militaries including Israel's. Either way they can fudge off with their political nonsense, hope they go under.”

That was the publisher's choice (Panic). If @house_house_ caring that much about palestinians then they should boycott SONY too. SONY literally sold equipment to various militaries including Israel's. Either way they can fudge off with their political nonsense, hope they go under https://t.co/UpektELDUj

— Meió Szetszuna 🏳️‍🌈🇭🇺 (@Meio_Szetszuna) October 15, 2026

Others pointed out that the developers’ previous game, Untitled Goose Game, is available on Xbox, while Big Walk is available on Steam, a digital distribution platform that allows users to purchase and download PC games. They argued that allowing Microsoft users to access the game through Steam raises questions about the consistency of House House’s boycott stance.

But Big Walk is available on Microsoft Windows and Untitled Goose Game is available on Xbox.

Seems performative to me. https://t.co/orICqaG7cA

— Dander the Wolf (@DanderThe) October 15, 2026

However, purchasing the game through Steam does not generate revenue for Microsoft in the same way that purchasing it through the Xbox would. 

It is also worth noting that House House released a statement in 2023 expressing support for the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination.

“An end to this genocide. An end to apartheid. Free Palestine,” the developers wrote. 

Now that we're back on here, we want to express our support for the Palestinian people, and their right to self-determination, safety and happiness.

An end to this genocide.
An end to apartheid.

Free Palestine. pic.twitter.com/ZBZwGCX4Wn

— House House (@house_house_) December 11, 2023

archive.security_status_en: Regional tensions are escalating sharply due to direct military threats against Iran, incidents in the Strait of Hormuz, and political pressure on Lebanon. Internal instability in Israel and Gaza, alongside cyberattacks on journalists, continue to deepen security risks.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued escalation of rhetoric surrounding Iran and heightened vigilance in Gulf shipping lanes are expected. Diplomatic pressures on Israel and Lebanon will continue to strain regional stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává vysoce napjatá v důsledku hrozeb nových amerických úderů na Írán, politických změn v Iráku a přetrvávající nestability v Gaze a Libanonu. Kritická infrastruktura a námořní trasy v Zálivu čelí rostoucím hrozbám po útocích na energetická zařízení v Sýrii a lodní dopravu.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation remains highly tense due to threats of fresh US strikes on Iran, political shifts in Iraq, and persistent instability in Gaza and Lebanon. Critical infrastructure and Gulf shipping lanes face rising threats following attacks on energy assets in Syria and maritime shipping.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci rétoriky mezi USA a Íránem a zvýšené bezpečnostní opatření v oblasti Zálivu. Politická nestabilita v Iráku a tlak na diplomatická řešení v Libanonu a Gaze budou nadále hýbat trhy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of rhetoric between the US and Iran and heightened security measures in the Gulf region are expected. Political instability in Iraq and pressure for diplomatic solutions in Lebanon and Gaza will continue to move markets.

archive.security_status_cs: V regionu nadále přetrvává vysoké napětí kvůli aktivitám v okolí Hormuzského průlivu a rostoucím obavám z širší konfrontace s Íránem, přestože USA signalizují omezení některých vojenských možností. Izrael se připravuje na blížící se parlamentní volby, zatímco v Gaze a Sýrii přetrvávají vážné humanitární a bezpečnostní výzvy včetně napětí na syrské hranici.
archive.security_status_en: High tension persists in the region due to incidents around the Strait of Hormuz and mounting concerns over a broader confrontation with Iran, even as the US signals limitations on certain military actions. Israel is preparing for upcoming parliamentary elections, while grave humanitarian and security challenges persist in Gaza and Syria, including border tensions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující diplomatický tlak kolem íránského jaderného programu a zvýšenou volatilitu na trzích s ropou v důsledku situace v Zálivu. Politická kampaň v Izraeli bude nadále dominovat místnímu zpravodajství a ovlivňovat tržní náladu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued diplomatic pressure regarding Iran's nuclear program and heightened volatility in oil markets due to the Gulf situation are expected. Israel's political campaign will continue to dominate local news and influence market sentiment.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává vysoce napjatá kvůli přetrvávajícím střetům na Západním břehu, eskalaci kolem dodávek do Gazy a diplomatickým jednáním ohledně Sýrie a Libanonu. Írán navzdory sankcím nadále částečně exportuje energie, zatímco napětí v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu navyšuje rizika pro námořní dopravu a dodávky ropy.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains highly tense due to ongoing clashes in the West Bank, escalation regarding aid deliveries to Gaza, and diplomatic maneuvers concerning Syria and Lebanon. Despite sanctions, Iran continues partial energy exports, while rising tensions near the Strait of Hormuz increase risks to maritime traffic and oil supplies.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued diplomatic maneuvers regarding Syria and Lebanon are expected, while tensions in the Strait of Hormuz will continue to maintain heightened nervousness in oil markets.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v Gaze a na Západním břehu zůstává vysoce nestabilní kvůli pokračujícím střetům, přičemž mezinárodní tlak na Izrael roste kvůli humanitární krizi a osadnickému násilí. Současně eskaluje napětí v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu, kde dochází k útokům na plavidla a roste americký a spojenecký vojenský dohled.
archive.security_status_en: The situation in Gaza and the West Bank remains highly volatile amid ongoing clashes, with international pressure mounting on Israel over the humanitarian crisis and settler violence. Simultaneously, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz are escalating with vessel attacks and heightened US and allied military posture.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic friction regarding the West Bank and Gaza is expected, while disruptions to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz will continue to sustain high volatility in oil prices.
